description: This file defines the PurgeableBitmapView class, a custom Android View that demonstrates the handling of purgeable Bitmaps. It performs bitmap decoding, rendering, and memory management for testing purposes within an Android application.

classes.name: PurgeableBitmapView
classes.description: A custom View for demonstrating purgeable Bitmap behavior, including decoding and drawing bitmaps, while managing memory consumption.

methods.name: PurgeableBitmapView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view with purgeable options and prepares the bitmap data.

methods.name: createColors
methods.description: Generates an array of color values to create a bitmap with a gradient pattern.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Decodes a bitmap from a bitstream, updates internal state, and handles memory errors.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the View's onDraw method to render the bitmap and display decoding information.

methods.name: generateBitstream
methods.description: Encodes a Bitmap into a JPEG format and returns the byte array.
